name: Worn Leather Boots
description: A pair of scuffed leather boots, cracked at the toe but still wearable. Better than going barefoot.

name: Rough Hide Cap
description: A cap stitched together from various scraps of hide. Offers minimal protection but keeps your head dry.

name: Leather Jerkin
description: A simple leather vest worn by hunters and travelers. Lightweight and flexible, providing basic protection without slowing you down.

name: Cloth Wraps
description: Strips of rough cloth wound around the hands. Hardly armour, but they protect your knuckles.

name: Hardened Leather Boots
description: Boots reinforced with hardened leather plates at the shin and toe. Standard issue for scouts and rangers.

name: Leather Hood
description: A fitted leather hood that covers the neck and temples. Popular among rogues and outriders.

name: Studded Leather Cuirass
description: A leather chest piece reinforced with iron studs. Offers reasonable protection while preserving freedom of movement.

name: Leather Gloves
description: Well-fitted leather gloves with padded knuckles. A favourite of archers and thieves alike.

name: Ranger Boots
description: Masterfully crafted boots of layered leather and treated hide. Silent on any surface, tough enough for any terrain.

name: Scout's Helmet
description: A lightweight helm of boiled leather reinforced at the crown. Favoured by those who value speed over brute protection.

name: Ranger's Cuirass
description: A finely crafted cuirass of layered leather and boiled hide, fitted to the wearer's form. Light enough to sprint in, tough enough to stop an arrow.

name: Archer's Gloves
description: Supple, reinforced leather gloves cut to allow a clean bowstring draw. The palm is doubly padded.

name: Chainmail Coif
description: A simple hood of interlinked iron rings. Heavy on the neck but offers solid protection from slashing blows.

name: Chainmail Hauberk
description: A long shirt of interlocked iron rings reaching to the thighs. Heavy to wear but difficult to cut through.

name: Iron Sabatons
description: Segmented iron plates protecting the foot and ankle. Clunky but effective.

name: Iron Helm
description: A sturdy iron helmet with a nose guard. Dents before it breaks, and the dents can be hammered out.

name: Iron Cuirass
description: A solid iron breastplate, front and back. Heavy enough to slow you down but reliable against most weapons.

name: Iron Gauntlets
description: Articulated iron gauntlets. Your fists become weapons in their own right.

name: Steel Sabatons
description: Fully articulated steel foot armour. Expensive to make, nearly impossible to break.

name: Nasal Helmet
description: A well-crafted steel helmet with a prominent nasal guard and cheek plates. A veteran's helmet.

name: Brigandine
description: A coat of small steel plates riveted between layers of tough canvas. Flexible protection favoured by seasoned soldiers.

name: Steel Gauntlets
description: Heavy articulated gauntlets of tempered steel. A blow from these is not easily forgotten.

name: Knight's Greaves
description: Full plate leg and foot armour. Walking is slow, fighting is devastating.

name: Full Helm
description: A fully enclosed plate helmet with a narrow visor. Excellent protection at the cost of visibility and hearing.

name: Plate Cuirass
description: A heavy plate breastplate and backplate joined at the sides. Standard armour for heavy infantry.

name: Plate Gauntlets
description: Thick plate gauntlets. Your hands are practically invulnerable. Opening doors is another matter.

name: Plate Sabatons
description: Masterwork full-enclosure plate sabatons. Each step rings out like a hammer on an anvil.

name: Great Helm
description: A towering cylindrical helmet of thick plate. Nearly impervious to blows from above. Wearing one announces that you mean business.

name: Knight's Plate
description: Full-coverage plate armour of the finest make. The kind worn by those who can afford to survive any battle. Heavy as a millstone.

name: Knight's Gauntlets
description: Fluted plate gauntlets with articulated fingers, the mark of a true knight. Beautifully made and brutally effective.
